description: This Java source file defines the class EmojiKeyboardsExtractor, which is responsible for parsing emoji data, managing emoji collectors, generating emoji keyboard resources, and creating XML configuration files for emoji quick-text addons within an Android application.

classes.name: EmojiKeyboardsExtractor
classes.description: Main class responsible for parsing emoji data, managing emoji collectors, generating resource files, and creating XML configuration files for emoji quick-text addons.

classes.name: StaticEmojiCollector
classes.description: A static implementation of the EmojiCollection interface representing predefined emoji collections with fixed resource identifiers and metadata.

methods.name: parseEmojiListIntoKeyboardResources
methods.description: Parses the emoji list, collects emojis via collectors, and stores them into resource files, also generating XML configuration for quick-text addons.

methods.name: storeEmojisToResourceFiles
methods.description: Stores collected emojis into resource files and generates XML files for quick-text addons, handling errors and static addon collections.

methods.name: addAddOnToXmlNode
methods.description: Adds a quick-text addon node to the XML document based on the provided emoji collection.

methods.name: getStaticAddOnCollectors
methods.description: Returns an array of predefined static emoji collectors for quick-text addons.
